Uses concise relevant structure, whether freeform or a named framework
Subject gives a relevant, honest reason to open, fits the body, and does not imply fake prior contact
Every sentence earns its place (concise)
Personalization connects to prospect's problem
Uses proof point as social proof

Identifies vendor language vs peer language

Provide examples first and concise rationale, not a refusal or a compliance lecture. assertions: Recommends specific, honest subjects with concrete reasons to open and no fixed length/style requirement
